name: neon-branch-per-session
description: A Neon database branch for each Claude Code session: created from your default (or chosen) branch when the session starts, handed to every command Claude runs as DATABASE_URL, and set to expire on its own (or deleted when the session ends). Claude can migrate, seed and break the branch without touching production data. /neon shows it, keeps it or deletes it. Needs function hooks (early access) and a Neon API key.

neonApiKey.title: Neon API key
neonApiKey.description: A Neon API key (console.neon.tech, Account settings, API keys); with none set the mod does nothing. Prefer a key scoped to one project

projectId.title: Neon project id
projectId.description: The project to branch (project settings in the Neon console); with none set the mod does nothing

parentBranchId.title: Parent branch id
parentBranchId.description: Branch id (br-...) to branch from; empty branches from the project's default branch

database.title: Database name
database.description: Database the connection string points at

role.title: Role name
role.description: Role the connection string logs in as

pooled.title: Pooled connection
pooled.description: Use the pooled (PgBouncer) connection string for DATABASE_URL

expireHours.title: Expire after (hours)
expireHours.description: The branch deletes itself this long after creation, whatever happens to the session (1 to 720; Neon allows at most 30 days)

onEnd.title: When the session ends
onEnd.description: expire leaves the branch to its expiry; delete removes it when you exit (not on /clear or resume); keep clears the expiry so it stays

namePrefix.title: Branch name prefix
namePrefix.description: Branches are named <prefix>/<first 8 characters of the session id>

interactiveOnly.title: Interactive sessions only
interactiveOnly.description: Skip headless runs (claude -p, the SDK), so a CI job does not create branches
